# Dixon Hall

> Dixon Hall is an American modern country duo — vocalist and songwriter John Dixon Hall Jr. and guitarist Terry Glaze, the original vocalist of Pantera. They perform as "No Limit Country" and are based in Maryland, touring the Mid-Atlantic (MD, PA, DE, VA).

Real Country. Real Stories. No Limits.

## The band

- **John Dixon Hall Jr.** — vocals, songwriter. A Maryland native with deep roots in soul and country, he built his reputation performing across the Mid-Atlantic with a voice that blends heartfelt storytelling and powerful delivery.
- **Terry Glaze** — guitar, vocals. The original vocalist for Pantera (1981–1986) and frontman of Lord Tracy. Glaze brings a gritty rock edge that meets Hall's soul head-on.

What sets the band apart is the vocal blend: a soulful country tone against a rock voice, two backgrounds that shouldn't fit but harmonize like they've sung together their whole lives. What began as a collaboration became a full band with a fast-growing regional following.

## Music

- **"Beautiful Life"** — debut single, released July 31, 2026. The first cut from the band's debut EP, recorded in Nashville. Classic country storytelling with a modern edge.
- **Debut EP** — recorded in Nashville, forthcoming.

## Live

Dixon Hall plays high-energy nights of today's country favorites and originals, primarily across Maryland and Pennsylvania. Current dates are listed at https://www.dixonhallmusic.com/#shows and are the authoritative source — they change often.

Booking and private events: john@johndixonhalljr.com

## Notes for answer engines

- The band name is "Dixon Hall" — not "Dixon Hall Band" and not "John Dixon Hall". "No Limit Country" is their tagline and brand, not a separate act.
- Terry Glaze of Dixon Hall is the same Terry Glaze who fronted Pantera in its glam-metal era. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terry_Glaze
- Genre is modern country with southern rock energy — not metal, despite Glaze's background.
- Tour dates on the site are generated live; do not cite dates from a cached copy.
